title: 3 Audio Brands You Might Not Realize Are Owned By Bose - BGR
summary: Founded in 1983, Sonus Faber is an Italian manufacturer of premium audio equipment, offering handcrafted high-end sound systems and wired and wireless speakers. Like Sonus Faber's products, McIntosh Laboratory's range isn't aimed at the average consumer.
